title: coach-review eval cases
description: Shape of cases.local.json (gitignored, real cases) and cases.example.json (synthetic). Real activity ids, the athlete's wording and incident-derived expectations belong only in cases.local.json.

id.description: Path-safe case id (also the trace / output file stem)

pattern.description: The generic failure pattern the case guards against (see README)

notes.description: Free text for the case author; never sent to a model

logged.description: Incident log (indicators.mjs): the date the incident was recorded

source.description: Incident log: who found it (owner = an owner correction)

recurs_of.description: Incident log: id of an earlier case of the same kind of error

must.description: Judge-checked behaviours the output must show

must_not.description: Judge-checked behaviours the output must not show

forbid_regex.description: Regexes (JS, u flag) that must not match the prose

forbid_growth_point_moment_kinds.description: run_note: moment kinds a growth point must not cite

required_evidence_prefixes.description: run_note: each prefix must start at least one cited evidence key
